The '''Dragon's Breath''' is an ancient blue aura that is projected from the [[Dragon's Cliffs]] and points the way to [[Avalon]]. It is not a physical bridge and anyone who attempts to step on it will pass straight through it. The mist trail is activated by powering up the two lamps on either side of the cliffs. 

== History ==
[[Nostradamus]]' quatrains informed the Huntik team to the Dragon's Breath would point the way to Avalon. [[Cherit]] lit up the lamps with his energy charge, activating the light. [[Unnamed Suit 055|Suits 055]] and [[Unnamed Suit 058|058]] interrupted them and forced them to step aside. They then attempted to cross, not realising that it was not a physical bridge, falling into the water below. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}
